name: Governance as Code · System card
purpose: A governed supplier-invoice and contract-validation workflow: deterministic checks, evidence-scoped AI advice for unresolved exceptions, and final human authority.
boundary: The reviewer remains responsible for the disposition. Agent recommendations are advisory, and the public site cannot approve or modify a case.

decisions.title: Deterministic verification
decisions.why: Model agreement is not independent evidence.
decisions.choice: Verify material claims with Python checks against declared sources.
decisions.limit: A true calculation can still be misleading when context is missing.

decisions.title: Workflow and reasoning have different jobs
decisions.why: An LLM-driven process router would make routine state changes variable.
decisions.choice: Use LangGraph for workflow control and PydanticAI for bounded reasoning.
decisions.limit: State transitions remain separate from advisory model outputs.

decisions.title: A reconstructible process ledger
decisions.why: Retries after a human pause could duplicate audit records.
decisions.choice: Append events with stable identifiers and idempotent writes.
decisions.limit: An audit event does not prove that someone examined the evidence.

decisions.title: Pause for a named human decision
decisions.why: An exception cannot silently become a machine approval.
decisions.choice: Interrupt the workflow; resume with a typed reviewer decision.
decisions.limit: Final approval remains outside model authority.

decisions.title: One observability interface
decisions.why: Operational events and authoritative process history have different purposes.
decisions.choice: Expose an integration boundary without conflating live views and audit evidence.
decisions.limit: A live dashboard is not the canonical ledger.

decisions.title: Lessons do not silently change policy
decisions.why: Operational feedback can undermine reproducibility when fed back automatically.
decisions.choice: Separate the lessons channel from the running engine and review policy changes explicitly.
decisions.limit: Recording a lesson is not deploying a new rule.

decisions.title: Evidence-aware context budgets
decisions.why: Large prompts cost more and hide source selection.
decisions.choice: Document context compaction and token budgets while preserving important evidence.
decisions.limit: Compression must not discard the basis for a verdict.

decisions.title: Regulatory roles and evidence
decisions.why: Model and application responsibilities must not be conflated.
decisions.choice: Maintain intended-purpose, oversight and technical documentation linked to controls.
decisions.limit: Technical documentation does not itself establish certification.

decisions.title: Orchestration framework trade-off
decisions.why: Typed agent calls and stateful orchestration solve different problems.
decisions.choice: Keep the bounded hybrid and document alternatives for production migration.
decisions.limit: A future migration route is not a shipped capability.

decisions.title: Golden samples from review
decisions.why: Synthetic test examples are not a substitute for observed reviewer disagreements.
decisions.choice: Curate reviewer feedback into a separate evaluation channel.
decisions.limit: An observation needs review before becoming a benchmark.

decisions.title: Verification before and after synthesis
decisions.why: Filtering preliminary assertions does not protect the final Judge synthesis.
decisions.choice: Use pre-Judge and post-Judge claim verification with a bounded retry path.
decisions.limit: Verification remains limited by source quality.

decisions.title: Static site, protected runtime
decisions.why: A public reference page must not be mistaken for a live workflow.
decisions.choice: Use a static Next.js export for presentation and a separate protected API for execution.
decisions.limit: Public navigation cannot confer runtime permission.

decisions.title: Case-level access controls
decisions.why: Being signed in does not authorise access to every case.
decisions.choice: Check permissions for each case and its related records.
decisions.limit: A hidden UI control is not server-side authorisation.

decisions.title: A single guarded verification path
decisions.why: Separate verification entry points can enforce inconsistent budgets.
decisions.choice: Use one guarded verifier with explicit results and shared limits.
decisions.limit: Unsupported or neutral claims must remain labelled.

decisions.title: Reasons and a second reviewer
decisions.why: High-impact overrides need attribution and independent challenge.
decisions.choice: Require rationale and classified reasons; use dual review for specified actions.
decisions.limit: Attribution alone cannot establish reviewer attention.

decisions.title: Untrusted content boundary
decisions.why: External text can try to redirect the assistant's instructions.
decisions.choice: Sanitise, delimit and scrub text at the relevant model boundaries.
decisions.limit: Filtering never replaces structural permissions.

decisions.title: Revisions grounded in evidence
decisions.why: Repeating the original persuasive briefing can repeat its mistake.
decisions.choice: Give the retry relevant verification evidence.
decisions.limit: Revised wording must still be checked.

decisions.title: Capacity reservations before model calls
decisions.why: Rate limits can otherwise cause silent degradation during a run.
decisions.choice: Reserve capacity and wait within configured provider limits.
decisions.limit: Capacity reservations cannot guarantee service availability.

decisions.title: Fail-closed shared capacity limits
decisions.why: Local counters can miss concurrent workers or unknown models.
decisions.choice: Govern token and request budgets with a shared backend and deny unknown configurations.
decisions.limit: Missing limit settings must not mean unlimited use.

decisions.title: One case per model context
decisions.why: Case information may contaminate another case's reasoning.
decisions.choice: Isolate each model context and lint reusable lessons for case data.
decisions.limit: Context separation is not a claim about pretrained model memory.

decisions.title: Narrow Judge output, deterministic assembly
decisions.why: Complex nested generation contracts are fragile under model variation.
decisions.choice: Return a narrow structured draft and assemble scored findings in code.
decisions.limit: Model prose carries no automatic decision weight.

decisions.title: Purpose-built read-only audit assistant
decisions.why: An auditor needs evidence explanations rather than operational tools.
decisions.choice: Keep the audit persona read-only and separate from decision actions.
decisions.limit: An assistant explanation is not an independent assessment.

decisions.title: Preserve the whole verification path
decisions.why: A final answer can conceal rejected or revised claims.
decisions.choice: Record pre- and post-Judge checking with explicit outcomes.
decisions.limit: Only recorded checks can be represented as executed.

decisions.title: One coherent design language
decisions.why: Separate styling copies drift across public and protected surfaces.
decisions.choice: Share design tokens instead of copying ad-hoc presentation output.
decisions.limit: Visual unity must not conceal capability differences.

decisions.title: Attack wording beyond signatures
decisions.why: Pattern matching misses paraphrased prompt injections.
decisions.choice: Test against evolving adversarial language and record the guard's gaps.
decisions.limit: Passing known attacks does not prove complete resistance.

decisions.title: Optional semantic injection screening
decisions.why: Deterministic signatures cannot capture every adversarial intent.
decisions.choice: Allow an optional screen to add, but never remove, deterministic redactions.
decisions.limit: The screening model remains fallible and is off by default.

decisions.title: Exact-origin cross-origin policy
decisions.why: The public site and protected API do not share an origin.
decisions.choice: Permit only explicitly configured origins when cross-origin access is needed.
decisions.limit: Origin checks do not grant case access.

decisions.title: Named public API surfaces
decisions.why: Permitted origins alone do not restrict endpoint authority.
decisions.choice: Publish a deliberate allowlist of public routes.
decisions.limit: Protected actions must remain inaccessible from public mode.

decisions.title: Dual control uses distinct people
decisions.why: An unauthenticated demo cannot assume session IDs distinguish reviewers.
decisions.choice: Require distinct named reviewers for the relevant dual-control path.
decisions.limit: Names alone are not strong proof of identity.

decisions.title: Example workbook as a testable contract
decisions.why: The downloadable workbook must match what intake expects.
decisions.choice: Check field coverage, workbook structure and browser preflight.
decisions.limit: A sample workbook is not evidence of external integration.

decisions.title: Business-value narrative with evidence
decisions.why: Repeated and reordered claims obscure what has been measured.
decisions.choice: Show the KPI taxonomy once, separating observed measures from objectives.
decisions.limit: Desired productivity improvements are not measured outcomes.

decisions.title: Navigation by purpose
decisions.why: A scattered sidebar and anonymous blocks impede exploration.
decisions.choice: Group pages by user task and show typed module inputs and outputs.
decisions.limit: A module contract does not demonstrate a particular execution.

decisions.title: Supplier-invoice intake
decisions.why: A sample is not usable when the intake accepts a different workbook.
decisions.choice: Accept the published invoice structure at the intake boundary.
decisions.limit: Successful parsing is not contractual approval.

decisions.title: Figures derived from engineering mechanisms
decisions.why: Simplified diagrams can accidentally overstate safeguards.
decisions.choice: Show the implemented control mechanisms and use only grounded KPI evidence.
decisions.limit: Explanatory figures are not live run measurements.

decisions.title: Invoice runs as KPI evidence
decisions.why: Reference simulations do not prove measured end-to-end business value.
decisions.choice: Exercise invoice scenarios through available stages and report missing measures.
decisions.limit: Synthetic scenarios do not establish representative savings.
